vuln_statements.stmt_text: Cache the runtime fields needed after unlock to prevent use-after-free when multiple threads access the same PCM stream concurrently
vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the Second Evidence Set, the vulnerability involves accessing runtime fields without proper caching before unlocking in the PCM drain path. The comment at lines 2193-2194 explicitly warns about concurrent close() operations that could free runtime data while the current thread sleeps. Without caching these fields before releasing locks, a use-after-free vulnerability occurs when multiple threads access the same PCM stream simultaneously.

Line 2190 releases the group reference during the drain operation. Combined with the lack of runtime field caching mentioned in the vulnerability description, this reference release creates a window where concurrent close() operations can free the runtime structure while the current thread continues to access it, leading to use-after-free.
